delivery_model.blocked.approval_needs_ch: The frame document was already binding when this decision was proposed. Raise a change request on it; its approval approves the decision.
delivery_model.blocked.approval_not_read: The frame document is binding, but the delivery model has open errors. Fix them and the decision is approved.
delivery_model.blocked.approver_unknown: Four-eyes cannot be checked: the governance approval does not say who decided.
delivery_model.blocked.four_eyes_propose: Four-eyes: the person who proposed the decision also approved the frame document. Someone else has to propose or approve.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.country: Public clients: consider splitting works into trade and partial lots (source to be verified)
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.criteri: 5 = changes after award are cheap and simple.
5 = the price is fixed when the contract is signed.
5 = needs no private finance and suits staged budgets.
5 = the contractor's know-how shapes the design.
5 = the form rewards whole-life cost and performance.
5 = many capable bidders exist for this form.
5 = the owner needs little in-house capability.
5 = the owner keeps full control of design decisions.
5 = one party answers for design and construction.
5 = works can start before the design is complete.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.al: Owner, designers and builders sign one multi-party agreement and share risk and reward against a target.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.cm: A construction manager acts for the owner for a fee; the owner holds every trade contract directly.
A construction manager advises during design, then commits to a guaranteed maximum price and holds the trade contracts.
Construction manager at risk (two stage, GMP)
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.de: The owner's designers complete the design; one main contractor builds it and carries the trade interfaces.
The owner's designers complete the design; the owner awards and coordinates one construction contract per trade or lot.
Separate trade contracts (design, then bid per trade)
One contractor designs to the owner's requirements and builds; design risk sits with the contractor.
The owner's designer prepares the early design and is then transferred to the design and build contractor.
Design and build with novated designer
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.in: An integrator acts for the owner across design and construction packages and is accountable for the interfaces.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.ma: A management contractor is paid a fee and lets and manages the works packages under its own contracts.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.pa: A contractor is selected early on quality and fee, develops the price with the owner and commits at the second stage.
Two stage partnering (target cost or GMP)
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.pp: A project company designs, builds, finances, operates and maintains the asset and is paid for availability.
Public private partnership (design, build, finance, operate, maintain)
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.form.tu: One contractor carries total design and construction risk at a fixed price and hands over a working facility.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.name: Neutral delivery forms
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.rationa: The authority retains risks it controls, such as policy and law.
Allocate to the party best able to manage the risk at least cost (World Bank PPP guidance).
A concession transfers design, build and lifecycle risk to the project company (World Bank PPP guidance).
The party that controls means and methods controls this risk.
The contractor designs, so design risk follows design responsibility.
Whoever produces the design is best placed to control its errors.
Covered by the project insurance arranged for the works.
Only the owner decides scope, so the owner carries its changes.
The owner commissioned the site investigation and holds the information.
The owner holds the trade contracts and therefore their interfaces.
The parties share overrun and underrun against the target.
A fixed price at award transfers this risk to the contractor.
Under remeasurement the owner pays for actual quantities and prices.
Usually relieved by statute or the standard form; the owner carries the cost.
The manager carries it within the guaranteed maximum price.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.ar: Finds that stop or change the works.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.ch: New laws, codes or standards after award.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.co: The facility not meeting its performance at handover.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.de: Clashes and gaps between design disciplines.
Errors and omissions in the design.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.en: Contaminated land and hazardous materials found.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.gr: Ground and groundwater differing from the reports.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.in: Damage to the works and third parties covered by insurance.
Gaps and overlaps between separately let packages.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.op: The asset not being available in operation.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.pe: Conditions imposed or changed by the authority.
Getting the permits the works need, on time.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.qu: Measured quantities differing from the estimate.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.sc: Late completion not caused by the owner.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.su: Insolvency or failure of a subcontractor or supplier.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.ut: Unknown or misplaced services and existing structures.
delivery_model.catalogue.neutral.risk.we: Exceptional weather and events beyond control.
